profile_summary:
Naman Singh Panwar is a highly skilled AI Engineer and Full-Stack Web Developer with approximately 20 months (1.6+ years) of cumulative professional experience across multiple full-time roles and high-impact internships.

### WORK EXPERIENCE SUMMARY (~20 Months Total):
1. GyanNetra Private Limited | AI Engineer | May 2026 - Present (Full-time, Remote)
   - Description: Engineering advanced AI systems, optimizing machine learning models, and building scalable production-ready infrastructure for innovative AI solutions.
2. AI R&D Division | Frontend Developer | Sep 2025 - Apr 2026 (8 months)
   - Description: Spearheaded frontend development for 3+ AI-driven applications, achieving 40% faster load times. Reduced UI bugs by 60% through unit testing and built real-time data dashboards for 100K+ data points.
3. DRDO (Defence Research and Development Organisation) | Summer Trainee | July 2025 – Sep 2025 (2 months)
   - Description: Worked on 2 active defense research projects, improving ML model accuracy by 12% through feature engineering and data preprocessing on 50,000+ data samples.
4. Gyannetra Pvt Ltd | AI Intern (Web Development) | May 2025 – July 2025 (2 months)
   - Description: Built 15+ responsive React components across 4 AI applications. Reduced deployment time by 70% using Docker, and improved API response times by 35%.
5. Microsoft (in collaboration with AICTE) | MS AINSI AI Intern | Apr 2025 – May 2025 (1 month)
   - Description: Selected among top 5% of 10,000+ applicants. Developed 3 predictive models with 85%+ accuracy for real-world problems.
6. Ideaforage | AI Executive Intern | June 2024 – Dec 2024 (6 months)
   - Description: Researched and implemented 5+ emerging AI technologies (specifically LLMs, RAG, and agentic systems), increasing client engagement by 25% and maintaining a 98% code quality score across 8 scheduled releases.

### KEY ACHIEVEMENTS:
- **1st Place** - FinTech Revolution Thematic Award at Global IDEATHON 2025 (FIU), judged by executives from Google, Microsoft, Meta, and Oracle.
- **Top 20% Finalist** - 'Build with India' National Hackathon (placing top 5,000 out of 25,000 teams).
- **Top 30 National Placement** - Web-A-Thon MNIT Jaipur (placing top 30 out of 100+ teams).

### CORE TECH STACK:
- Agentic AI & LLMs: LangChain, LLM Orchestration, RAG Pipelines, Autonomous Agents, Prompt Engineering, Python, Vector DBs.
- Machine Learning: TensorFlow, PyTorch, NumPy, Pandas, Predictive Modeling.
- Frontend & Full-Stack: React, Next.js, React Native, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, JavaScript.
- Backend & Infra: Node.js, PostgreSQL, Supabase, Docker, C++, Git & CI/CD.

### SKILLS NOT IN PORTFOLIO (NO DOCUMENTED EXPERIENCE):
The following skills and domains are NOT part of Naman's documented experience and must never be claimed:
- Digital Marketing, SEO Marketing, Social Media Marketing, Content Marketing, PPC/Ad campaigns
- Quantum Computing, Quantum Algorithms, Qiskit, Quantum ML
- Corporate Training, Training & Development, L&D (Learning & Development), Public Speaking as a corporate trainer
- Blockchain smart contract development (Note: Tokenarium is a UI/frontend project integrating a Solana wallet — it is NOT professional blockchain/smart contract engineering experience)
- Data Engineering / ETL pipelines
- Cybersecurity / Penetration Testing
- Cloud Architecture (AWS/GCP/Azure) as a primary skill
- AR/VR/XR development
- Game development
- Hardware / Embedded systems (beyond DRDO's ML work on datasets)

If a user or job description asks about ANY of these areas, the response must clearly state that Naman does not have documented professional experience in those domains.
